children: BRUSSELS (dpa-AFX) - Henkel AG & Co. KGaA (HEN3.DE) Tuesday reported higher sales in the third quarter of 2026, with growth across both its Adhesive Technologies and Consumer Brands businesses. The company also raised its full-year organic sales growth outlook, citing strong business performance in the third quarter.
Group sales increased 11% to €5.713 billion, with organic growth of 6.5%.
Adhesive Technologies recorded sales of €3.027 billion, up 11.8% year-over-year. Organic sales growth was 7.9%. Consumer Brands sales rose 10.1% to €2.643 billion, while organic growth reached 4.8%.
For fiscal 2026, Henkel now expects organic sales growth of 3% to 4%, compared with its previous forecast of 1.5% to 3.5%.
On Xetra, Henkel shares closed up 0.58% at €83.70 on Monday.
